explanation: This tests double integrals through lower and upper Riemann sums, absent from the supplied Linear Algebra topics, so it is prerequisite. Telescoping gives (L+U)/2=(10²−8²)(3−1)−2(3²−1²)(10−8)−3(3−1)(10−8)=72−32−12=28. Also U−L=ΣΣ(2Δy_j+4Δx_i)Δx_iΔy_j tends to zero as the mesh tends to zero. Thus both sums converge to 28.
